questions.prompt: Why should the deque keep indices rather than only values?

choices.label: To count how often each numeric value appears.
choices.feedback: An index tells whether a candidate is still inside the current k-element window.

choices.label: To tell when a candidate leaves the window.
choices.feedback: An index tells whether a candidate is still inside the current k-element window.

choices.label: To sort the output by the original positions.
choices.feedback: An index tells whether a candidate is still inside the current k-element window.

questions.prompt: Where should smaller candidates be removed when a new value arrives?

choices.label: From the back, while they are smaller than the new value.
choices.feedback: A newer larger value outlasts those smaller trailing candidates; the front retains the maximum.

choices.label: From either end without comparing their values.
choices.feedback: A newer larger value outlasts those smaller trailing candidates; the front retains the maximum.

choices.label: From the front only.
choices.feedback: A newer larger value outlasts those smaller trailing candidates; the front retains the maximum.
